exposure: symptoms of depression (via Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale)
outcome: relative abundances of individual bacterial taxa
cohort: A cohort of 171 pregnant women were studied, with data collected across all trimesters of pregnancy and into the early postpartum period.
finding: The study found no significant associations between stress-related variables (perceived stress, cortisol levels, symptoms of depression and anxiety) and gut microbiota diversity, microbial community composition, or relative abundances of individual bacterial taxa after controlling for false positive findings.
